input.question: how do zits form, and why does popping certain zits hurt like a bitch (lip line) and others don't (forehead)
input.ground_truth: There are different kinds of breakout. Whiteheads and blackheads are simply clogged pores; the oil in the pore is either blocked, trapping the bacteria in the pore, or it is exposed to air, where the bacteria oxidizes and forms a whitehead. A pimple, or zit, when the bacteria deeper down in the pore becomes infected and inflamed, and these can be painful. Depending on the location, you can experiences different degrees of pain. There are many more sensitive nerve endings around the lip area, so you feel so many more sensations. That's why kissing someone feels so good, and why cold sores hurt like a mutha.

So, the best advice is to not squeeze any pimples because it can make them hurt more or even leave marks!
